sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Nickel and gold miners are decoupling from coal, driven by EV battery demand and global rate-cut expectations that lift precious metal prices structurally.
Indonesia's downstream processing mandates and export restrictions continue to favor integrated miners with smelting capacity, creating durable cost advantages.
Energy transition capex and government push for domestic refining are re-rating mid-cap miners, but liquidity spikes like ALKA signal short-term froth requiring selective entry.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in nickel and gold names (BRMS, NEM, AMMN) as the IDX mining rally broadens beyond coal; ALKA's spike is speculative—take profits. Favor MBMA and COAL for sustained volume, but rotate into precious metals if the US dollar weakens further. Set tight stops on PSAB given its volatility.

themes: Indonesia's mandatory biodiesel B35 and 2030 renewable-energy mix target of 23% are forcing domestic conglomerates to accelerate solar and EV-battery supply-chain capex, creating durable demand for lo

US IRA production-tax-credit clarity and falling module costs are driving a second wave of utility-scale solar and storage deployments, benefiting inverter and optimizer makers (SEDG, ENPH) with US ma

Grid bottlenecks and data-center load growth are pushing vertically integrated energy firms (NRG) to pair gas peakers with solar-plus-storage hybrids, but pure-play climate-tech names with export opti
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US solar equipment (SEDG, ENPH) and Indonesian EV-chassis names (VKTR) on relative strength; the WATCH signal favors selective accumulation over broad beta. Rotate out of hydrogen (PLUG) and legacy utilities (NRG) into pure-play renewables with visible order books. sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Palm-oil upstream integration is now the key FMCG alpha driver, as CPO price resilience lifts margins for vertically integrated consumer names like BWPT and COIN beyond pure plantation peers.
Domestic consumption recovery is uneven but real, favoring food-and-beverage players with distribution scale (BOGA, CRSN) over discretionary snack makers (NAYZ) that face input-cost stickiness.

Foreign-flow rotation into Indonesian consumer staples is amplifying US risk-on sentiment, creating tactical windows in mid-caps (EL, BRRC) but demanding exit discipline as valuations re-rate quickly.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG laggards with earnings visibility (BOGA, CRSN) and ride the palm-oil-linked consumer names (BWPT, COIN) as CPO stays firm; trim AGAR/NAYZ into strength. Sector breadth is positive but US-driven, so keep beta low and rotate into names with local volume recovery and margin tailwinds from stable rupiah.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Ethereum's sustained outperformance (+17.7%) is pulling L2 ecosystems (ARB, MNT) higher, creating a durable beta trade as institutional staking and ETF flows expand.
Indonesia's crypto tax framework (0.1% PPh) and growing retail exchange volumes make digital assets a structural allocation, but local regulatory enforcement remains a volatility catalyst.
Liquidity-driven altcoin spikes (LIT +23%, HYPE +21%) signal speculative risk-on appetite that historically precedes sharp mean reversion, favoring tactical exits over holds.
sectors.ai: Rotate into ETH-linked and L2 plays (ARB, MNT) as the +17.7% ETH surge confirms institutional rotation; LIT's +23% signals liquidity-event speculation, but take profits on meme-driven PEPE. Indonesia's retail crypto adoption is rising, yet regulatory clarity lags—favor liquid global names over local proxies. Hedge with stablecoin yield positions if BTC fails to confirm above prior highs.
